plan.notes: Source: official TJC 2025-2026 Catalog with Addendum (catoid=15), Program: Communications: Speech, AA (poid=2779). Major Courses: 16 credits; TJC Core Curriculum: 44 credits; Total Semester Hours: 60. Either SPCH 1315 or SPCH 1321 is used to fulfill the Communications core requirement, but both are required for the award. 'OR' options modeled per course choice_note (first-listed option used). The catalog prints 'SPCH x3xx - Speech Elective' (3 cr) in semesters 3 and 4: select two of SPCH 1342 Voice & Diction, SPCH 2333 Discussion and Small Group Communication, SPCH 2341 Oral Interpretation. The catalog prints 'xxxx x1xx - Elective' (1 cr): any Academic Transfer course. Courses marked * are recommended core courses; other core courses may satisfy the same requirements. Prerequisites are not listed on the program page; see the catalog course descriptions. TCCNS codes included for Texas transfer reference.
